social:piasnews-social-985819e91afbf9a7:.source_text: Oscar on understanding and addressing the car’s difficulties for @Racingnews365: “It was clear at the beginning of the season that they were going to be quite different, but mainly from the power unit side of things. The actual cars themselves are smaller, they have less downforce, so of course they're always going to be different, but I think the first few races we were really occupied with the power unit and how to get the most out of that. “After the first few races, and especially after they tweaked some of the rules, it became a bit more normal, and that's when we really dug deep into what the car itself is like. “It wasn't that easy to drive, and it's still not been easy to drive, even now. So, pretty early on we identified that it was going to be challenging. It took us a while to understand exactly what needed to change, and then trying to actually change it is tough. “But we're making progress with it slowly, and that's all we can keep trying to do. So yeah, that's been the biggest thing. We recognized pretty early on that the car had some things that were tricky to manage.” [via @mesandor and @ianparkesf1]
social:piasnews-social-985819e91afbf9a7:.zh: Oscar谈理解并解决赛车困难，接受@Racingnews365采访：“赛季初就很明显它们会相当不同，但主要是在动力单元方面。赛车本身更小，下压力更少，所以当然它们总会不一样，但我觉得前几场比赛我们真的都在忙于动力单元以及如何把它发挥到极致。“前几场比赛之后，尤其是他们调整了一些规则之后，情况变得稍微正常了一些，那时我们才真正深入研究赛车本身是什么样的。“它开起来并不那么容易，甚至到现在也还是不容易。所以很早我们就意识到这将会很有挑战性。我们花了一段时间才确切理解需要改变什么，然后真正去改变它又很难。“但我们在慢慢取得进展，这就是我们能继续努力做的全部。所以是的，那一直是最主要的事情。我们很早就意识到这辆车有一些难以处理的地方。”[via @mesandor 和 @ianparkesf1]

social:piasnews-social-653b606d56f3e1a1:.source_text: Oscar on missing the intensity of a championship fight despite a more relaxed season, via @Racingnews365: “I want to be in a championship fight every year if I can be, but also, it's definitely a bit more relaxed this year. Obviously, we're not wanting to be in this position, but there's not quite the same stress. “But that stress that you have in a championship fight is the feeling you want because it means you're fighting for something that is what your goal is. I am missing that feeling this year for sure, and it adds a bit of extra intensity and things like that. “But yeah, it's not all... there are some things that are a little bit easier when you're not in a championship.” [via @mesandor and @ianparkesf1]
social:piasnews-social-653b606d56f3e1a1:.zh: Oscar谈尽管赛季更轻松但仍怀念冠军争夺的紧张感，via @Racingnews365：“如果可以，我想每年都参与冠军争夺，但今年也确实轻松了一些。显然，我们并不想处于这个位置，但压力没那么大了。“但你在冠军争夺中感受到的那种压力正是你想要的感觉，因为那意味着你在为你目标中的东西而战。今年我确实怀念那种感觉，它会带来一些额外的紧张感之类的。“但是的，也不是全都……当你不在冠军争夺中时，有些事情会稍微容易一些。”[via @mesandor 和 @ianparkesf1]

social:piasnews-social-271a9c60aee7a95b:.source_text: oscar on not being in the title fight: "i want to be in the fight every year. the stress you have in a championship fight is the feeling you want; it means you're fighting for your goal. i'm missing that feeling, but some things are a little easier when you're not in the fight." https://t.co/0XdA00RqKm

social:piasnews-social-469b7450aa179b3b:.source_text: oscar on his team growing stronger this year: "definitely between myself, and the pretty close and intimate engineering team around me, we've learned a lot about each other and how we get the most out of ourselves. it's been a good process to go through for sure." https://t.co/3cGNA2RLnn
social:piasnews-social-469b7450aa179b3b:.zh: Oscar谈今年他的团队变得更强：“绝对是在我自己和身边相当紧密亲近的工程团队之间，我们对彼此以及如何发挥出最大潜力有了很多了解。这肯定是一个很好的过程。”

social:piasnews-social-6742a1f6c0bce9d3:.source_text: oscar on what's brought him joy this year: "trying to make progress. i've always tried to remove results from what success looks like. sometimes a successful weekend is improvement rather than perfection. there's been very strong weekends this year i've been really happy with." https://t.co/Oxwy9k8xg9
social:piasnews-social-6742a1f6c0bce9d3:.zh: Oscar谈今年什么给他带来快乐：“努力取得进步。我一直试图把结果从成功的定义中剔除。有时候一个成功的周末是进步而非完美。今年有一些非常强劲的周末，我对此非常满意。”

social:piasnews-social-c6afca0be097b8a5:.source_text: oscar on switching off from f1: "it's a challenge, but outside of the track i enjoy the same things i always have - spending time with my girlfriend, having time to decompress, watch tv, play my sim & video games. they're the same things that bring me joy, that hasn't changed." https://t.co/GecSr51bMb
social:piasnews-social-c6afca0be097b8a5:.zh: Oscar谈如何从F1中抽离：“这是个挑战，但在赛道之外我享受一如既往的事情——和女朋友共度时光、有时间放松、看电视、玩模拟器和电子游戏。这些是同样带给我快乐的事情，没有改变。”

social:piasnews-social-7b1a1bbafb1aeb04:.source_text: oscar on how going through difficulties this year might help him in the future: "having that challenge has been tough, but getting through it and continuing to work on it is going to be rewarding and will hopefully set me up for whatever car we get in future." https://t.co/ypVnBvs6I2
social:piasnews-social-7b1a1bbafb1aeb04:.zh: Oscar谈今年经历困难可能如何帮助他未来：“面对那样的挑战很艰难，但挺过去并继续努力将是有回报的，希望能让我为未来无论得到什么车做好准备。”

social:piasnews-social-2894837dc48c7af4:.source_text: Q: can turn this picture back around next year? OP: using the off season to have a reset is going to be useful. i don't think these problems are going to solve themselves without putting a lot of effort into it, there's going to be a lot of hard work. https://t.co/ZpGuyK4hX6
social:piasnews-social-2894837dc48c7af4:.zh: 问：明年能把局面扭转回来吗？OP：利用休赛期进行重置会很有用。我不认为这些问题不投入大量努力就能自行解决，会有很多艰苦的工作。

social:piasnews-social-17a269a51aae1f64:.source_text: Q: why did last year unravel at the end? OP: a number of reasons. there was a couple of places where i struggled for pace. as a team we also would do some things differently if we did it again. the impact of some of those things was big sometimes. https://t.co/oZb1fS7Fpt
social:piasnews-social-17a269a51aae1f64:.zh: 问：为什么去年年底崩盘了？OP：有很多原因。有几个地方我在速度上很挣扎。作为车队，如果再来一次，我们也会做一些不同的事情。其中一些事情的影响有时很大。

social:piasnews-social-ff15b973d8dd52cb:.source_text: oscar on whether the struggles this year are the same, or related to, the struggles last year: "i wouldn't say so. some of the specific things from last year are maybe the same, but the general picture is quite different." https://t.co/EpFQOIPoqs
social:piasnews-social-ff15b973d8dd52cb:.zh: Oscar谈今年的挣扎是否与去年的挣扎相同或相关：“我不这么认为。去年的一些具体问题也许是一样的，但整体情况相当不同。”

social:piasnews-social-97acae86960e1208:.source_text: "the 1st half of the year was about understanding what i needed to change. it was difficult because some weekends were good & some bad; trying to understand why they were so different wasnt straightforward. the 2nd half has been actually trying to fix it." https://t.co/e6sfBritgs
social:piasnews-social-97acae86960e1208:.zh: “上半年是了解我需要改变什么。这很困难，因为有些周末很好，有些很糟；试图理解为什么它们如此不同并不简单。下半年实际上是在尝试解决它。”

social:piasnews-social-09ea086a942bcd46:.source_text: "a lot of the things that worked well for me in previous cars don't work this year, and a lot of things that you wanted to stay away from in previous cars are what you want to exploit this year. that rewiring has taken some getting used to." https://t.co/9X2lnyRnr9
social:piasnews-social-09ea086a942bcd46:.zh: “以前赛车上对我很有效的很多东西今年不管用了，而以前赛车上你想避开的很多东西今年反而是你想利用的。这种重新布线需要一些适应。”

social:piasnews-social-c1d09429e600447e:.source_text: Q: how much does racing more consciously impact your performance? OP: you ask any athlete when they're performing at their best: when you're not thinking about what you're doing, when you're in a state of flow. i havent been in a state of flow this year. https://t.co/I2PFFETsSn
social:piasnews-social-c1d09429e600447e:.zh: 问：更有意识地比赛对你的表现有多大影响？OP：你问任何运动员他们最佳状态时：当你不去想自己在做什么，当你处于心流状态。我今年还没有进入过心流状态。
